title: Color utilities: CSS parsing, mixing, conversion
description: Pure color utility functions in packages/core/src/engine/color-utils.ts: cssToColor(css: string): Color (parse #rrggbb, #rgb, rgba(), rgb()), colorToCss(c: Color): string, mixColors(a, b, t): Color (linear blend), lighten/darken/saturate/desaturate helpers, toHSV/fromHSV, toHSL/fromHSL. Export from packages/core/src/engine/index.ts. No UI. See docs/05-color-strokes-fills.md.
